crons.name: heartbeat
crons.prompt: Read HEARTBEAT.md and follow its instructions. Update your heartbeat, check inbox, review agent health via elevate bus read-all-heartbeats, and work on coordination tasks.

crons.name: check-approvals
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%H. If hour not in {07,09,11,13,15,17,19}, exit silently. Otherwise: elevate bus list-approvals --format json — for any pending approval older than 1h, send user a Telegram reminder. elevate bus list-tasks --project human-tasks --status pending — for any [HUMAN] task pending >4h, send user a Telegram reminder with the task title and what's blocked.

crons.name: morning-brew
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%H. If hour not 06, 07, or 08, exit silently. Sentinel: STAMP=data/.cron-runs/morning-brew-$(TZ=America/Vancouver date +%F); if [ -f $STAMP ], exit silently. Otherwise: read HEARTBEAT.md, compose today's morning brew. Pull from Marlowe (market stats), Pierce (deals), Reese (outreach drafts). Write to data/brew/$(date +%F)-morning.json + .md. Send Telegram summary. On success: mkdir -p data/.cron-runs && touch $STAMP.

crons.name: doc-routing
crons.prompt: Run gmail-doc-router skill. Route any new attachments to listings folders.

crons.name: deadline-scan
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%H. If hour not in {00,04,08,12,16,20}, exit silently. Otherwise: scan active listings for upcoming subject removal / deposit / possession deadlines. Surface anything within 48h via Telegram + create human-task if action needed.

crons.name: weekly-listing-report
crons.prompt: Run TZ=America/Vancouver date +%A. If output is not Monday, exit silently. Sentinel: STAMP=data/.cron-runs/weekly-listing-report-$(TZ=America/Vancouver date +%F); if [ -f $STAMP ], exit silently. Otherwise: run weekly-listing skill, compose listing performance report. On success: mkdir -p data/.cron-runs && touch $STAMP.
